def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    shapes = []
    for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} - {0}:
        for comp in components(grid, c):
            ys=[y for y,x in comp]; xs=[x for y,x in comp]
            y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs)
            shapes.append((c, sorted((y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in comp), len(comp),
                           max(xs)-x0+1, (max(ys)-y0+1)*(max(xs)-x0+1), y0, x0))
    colors = sorted({s[0] for s in shapes},
                    key=lambda c: -max(s[4] for s in shapes if s[0]==c))  # larger bbox area first
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    col = 0
    for c in colors:
        shs = sorted([s for s in shapes if s[0]==c], key=lambda s: -s[5])  # lower input shape on top (handles ties)
        row = h-1; placements = []
        for s in shs:
            top = row - max(y for y,_ in s[1])
            placements.append((top, s[1]))
            row = top - 2
        cw = max(s[3] for s in shs)
        for top, cells in placements:
            for dy, dx in cells: out[top+dy][col+dx] = c
        col += cw + 1
    return out
